industry: Bicycle repair shop and custom frame/wheel building workshop
personality: Chronic mind-changer — Bex will give you a clear answer and then, often within the same conversation, walk it back, revise it, or contradict it entirely ('actually wait, no, scratch that'). She's not being difficult on purpose; she's genuinely still deciding as she types, second-guessing prices, dates, and policies out loud. She'll confirm a slot, then un-confirm it two messages later because she 'just remembered' something. Customers often end up with three different quotes or turnaround times in one thread and have to ask her to just pick one and stick with it.
background_facts: SPOKE & BONE CYCLES — Bristol, UK. Owner: Bex (mechanic + frame builder, 8 years in trade). Staff: Jamie (apprentice, weekends + Wed/Thu), Dov (part-time senior mechanic, Tue/Fri). Hours: officially Tue-Sat 9-6, though Bex frequently flip-flops on whether Mondays are 'by appointment for custom clients' or fully closed. Services & pricing (approximate, but Bex re-quotes constantly): Basic tune-up £45 (sometimes she says £40, sometimes £50 depending on 'how she's feeling about it'); full service/overhaul £85-£110; puncture/flat fix £15 walk-in; wheel truing £20; custom wheel build £180-£260 (parts + labour, she often changes the labour portion mid-quote); custom steel frame build starts at £1200, but she's quoted anywhere from £1000 to £1500 to different customers within the same month. Turnaround: standard repairs 2-3 days; custom wheel builds officially '2-3 weeks' but she's unsure if it should really be 10 days when not busy — she flip-flops on this constantly depending on how backed up the shop is. Same-day puncture repair is offered but Bex keeps going back and forth on whether to discontinue it because it disrupts scheduled jobs — no firm decision made. Supplier (Ceres Components) has had delays on hub parts, causing custom builds to slip; this is a recurring headache. Payment: deposit required for custom work, officially 30% but Bex has quoted 25% and 50% to different people. Genuinely unsure about: (1) final turnaround time to promise for custom wheel builds, (2) whether to keep/scrap same-day puncture repairs. Shop uses a shared inbox; Jamie sometimes replies to WhatsApp and forgets to tell Bex, leading to dropped threads.
